pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft edge gradients. The spatial area is heterogeneous, featuring larger, elongated patches on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more sub-circular patches on the posterior and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white interstitial pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge against the background.
